gloss: to visit; to call on; to arrive (of a season, opportunity)

definitions.explanation: To go to see a person or place.

definitions.gloss: to arrive; to come (of seasons, opportunities, events)
definitions.explanation: For abstract things like seasons, opportunities, or changes to come or arrive.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}を{訪|おとず}れた。
{去年|きょねん}{初|はじ}めてその{寺|てら}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited that temple for the first time last year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}がこの{町|まち}を{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Many tourists visit this town every year.

examples.japanese: ついにチャンスが{訪|おとず}れた。
{長|なが}い{冬|ふゆ}が{終|お}わり、ようやく{暖|あたた}かい{春|はる}が{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: The long winter ended, and warm spring finally arrived.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) for visiting places/people
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) for seasons/events arriving

Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{下一段|しもいちだん})

CONJUGATION:
・{訪|おとず}れない (negative)
・{訪|おとず}れて (te-form)
・{訪|おとず}れた (past)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{訪|たず}ねる - to visit (also read たずねる)
・{訪問|ほうもん}する - to visit (formal)
・{来|く}る - to come (general)

NUANCE:
More literary and elegant than {訪|たず}ねる. Often used for the poetic sense of seasons or changes arriving.
